articles.title: Brazil’s securities regulator sets up task force with 60-day deadline for tokenization proposal
articles.snippet: The framework will address critical issues like official ownership records, private key custody, transaction reversibility and system liability.

articles.title: Bitcoin's biggest advocate, Michael Saylor, says new plan to clean up the blockchain is 'a bad idea'
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor argues that a new proposal, BIP-110, to temporarily block "spam" data from the Bitcoin blockchain would undermine the network's neutrality and create a dangerous precedent for censorship.

articles.title: Capital B approves 10-for-1 reverse stock split to broaden investor base
articles.snippet: Europe’s second-biggest Bitcoin treasury company said the September reverse stock split should attract more institutional investors to the French company.

articles.title: Cardano activates van Rossem hard fork
articles.snippet: The upgrade reduces smart contract execution costs while laying the groundwork for Ouroboros Leios, a major scalability upgrade expected later this year.

articles.title: OpenAI Uses AI Red Team to Strengthen GPT-5.6 Against Prompt Injection Attacks
articles.snippet: OpenAI said its new automated red-teaming model, GPT-Red, uncovered vulnerabilities that were used to make GPT-5.6 more resistant to prompt injection attacks.
